description: Seattle Real Time Fire 911 Calls is published by City of Seattle. The feed lists fire-service dispatches with times, incident types and locations. Its stated coverage is Seattle, United States; dispatch records refreshed every five minutes. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Feed refresh frequency does not establish timestamp accuracy or final incident classifications. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
